summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Hesai Group, a Chinese foreign private issuer, covering the month of April 2026. The exhibit index lists an annual report for the year ended December 31, 2025, published under Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing rules, and a 2025 Environmental, Social and Governance Report. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic report. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special-situation filing.
